why: Both share the same core of sofa, wingback armchair, light-wood tables, rug, chairs and bamboo pendant, so the difference is in the accessories. B's white curtains, light herringbone sideboard and extra green cushion fit the cream, light-wood Nordic brief better. A's darker checkerboard sideboard and beige curtains are warmer but less consistent with the light woods, and its swing-arm floor lamp suits the reading chair less well.
